$comment: One source of truth for the hosted checkout the E2E suites drive, in both PAYMOB_MODE=fake and PAYMOB_MODE=sandbox. `labels` is what Paymob's real checkout (eg.checkout.paymob.com) shows, as seen on the sandbox on 2026-10-08: the card fields have no visible labels, so they are found by their placeholders; the button reads `Pay EGP <amount>`, so `pay` is a prefix; an approved test card goes through 3-D Secure without a challenge and lands on `paid` before redirecting; a declined one stops on `declined` and does not redirect. The Paymob fake (apps/backend/test/fakes/paymob-server.ts) renders the same page from these values, and the Maestro subflow (apps/mobile/e2e/flows/_pay-checkout.yaml) and the Playwright driver (checkout-driver.mjs) type and tap by them, so a flow cannot tell which one it is on. If Paymob changes its page, update the values here and the fake follows.

approved.name: Test Account
approved.source: Paymob test credentials (developers.paymob.com, setup guides > test credentials).

declined.name: Test Account
declined.source: The Mastercard gateway's test convention: the expiry date picks the response. Confirmed on Paymob's sandbox on 2026-10-08 ("Payment declined — Do not honour").
